title: erodium malacoides
intro: Erodium malacoides, commonly known as Heron's pink, is a flowering plant in the geranium family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erodium malacoides include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
